packageRules.description: This action follows lolay/triage: VERSION pins the CLI it installs and equals the action's own release version. Open a dedicated PR as soon as triage releases (no cooldown on our own releases); after merging, tag vX.Y.Z to release the action.

customManagers.description: Track the triage CLI version pinned in VERSION (installed by install.sh when the `version` input is empty)
